# neocloud_virtual_network (Resource)

A private virtual network. `network_cidr` must fall inside `172.16.0.0/14` or `192.168.0.0/16` (upstream constraint).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `network_cidr` (String)
- `zone_id` (String)

### Optional

- `tags` (Map of String)
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `status` (String)
